title: Brooklyn Subway
subtitle: A customizable, connected subway map

steps.title: Power up
steps.text: Use the supplied 5 V, 3 A, center-positive barrel adapter. USB-C is for programming, not power. Keep the antenna attached to the frame.

steps.title: Connect your phone
steps.text: In your phone's Wi-Fi settings, join BrooklynMap-Avi. If it says no internet, choose Stay connected or Use without internet.

steps.title: Connect your map
steps.text: Open http://192.168.4.1/ if setup does not appear. Create and save a map settings password. Then select home Wi-Fi and enter the Wi-Fi password. The map needs 2.4 GHz; a shared 2.4/5 GHz name works.

steps.title: Open your map
steps.text: When setup says You're connected!, note the map's address. Rejoin home Wi-Fi on your phone, wait 10 seconds, then open that address in Safari or Chrome. Bookmark it. Train lights start when data is ready.

left_controls.title: TURN THE KNOB
left_controls.text: Browse screens. On Lines, press the knob, then turn to browse lines. Press again to leave line browsing.

left_controls.title: MODE
left_controls.text: Show one subway line. Turn the knob to choose. Press MODE again to restore your saved lines.

left_controls.title: TEST
left_controls.text: Runs each whole line in red, green and blue, about 15 seconds. Press POWER to stop.

right_controls.title: POWER
right_controls.text:
Starting with both displays on:
1st tap: map off, screen on
2nd tap: map on, screen off
3rd tap: both off   4th tap: both on
Hold 3 seconds to restart; settings stay saved.

right_controls.title: BRIGHT / DIM
right_controls.text: Adjust the display that is on by itself. They do nothing when both displays are on or off.

map_note: Default colors. Uses MTA reports and estimates, not GPS. Several trains can share one light.
warning: UPDATING? Do not unplug power. Wait for Update complete.
help_text:
Wi-Fi changed? Hold the knob for 10 seconds to reopen setup.
Support: Help > Make a support report. Copy/Save it or email The Developer (your saved contact). Set the name and email in Advanced > Personalization. Review before sending.
quiet_note: Quiet hours can darken the map or screen and mute sounds.
care_note: CARE: Unplug barrel power and USB before handling. Keep dry and out of direct sunlight. Do not move the OLED magnet or antenna.
